title: [FLINK-34224][state] Fix mailbox handling in changelog storage metrics tests
body:
## What is the purpose of the change

Fix FLINK-34224: asynchronous uploads in `ChangelogStorageMetricsTest` use `SyncMailboxExecutor`, which runs completion callbacks on the uploader thread. This can race with the test thread accessing the non-thread-safe `FsStateChangelogWriter`.

## Brief change log

- Use a mailbox bound to the test thread in the upload batch-size and retry-metrics tests.
- Drain the mailbox while waiting for upload futures, propagating upload failures.
- Wait for every writer's upload to complete before starting the next batch.

## Verifying this change

The affected tests are `testUploadBatchSizes`, `testAttemptsPerUpload`, and `testTotalAttemptsPerUpload` in `ChangelogStorageMetricsTest`.

- Passed: `./mvnw -B -pl flink-dstl/flink-dstl-dfs spotless:check` (Java 17).
- Passed: `git diff --check origin/master...HEAD`.
- Passed: `./mvnw -B -pl flink-dstl/flink-dstl-dfs -am -Dtest=ChangelogStorageMetricsTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false test` (Java 17): all 7 tests passed, with no failures, errors, or skips.
- Passed: [Azure Pipelines build #80391](https://dev.azure.com/apache-flink/apache-flink/_build/results?buildId=80391&view=results): all 13 jobs succeeded for commit `a683d4e9bdca36a1393c7b5c2536f93a7adf129c`.
- Local full verification (`./mvnw -B clean verify`, Java 17) was interrupted after it stopped making progress in `CollectSinkFunctionRandomITCase`; the CI result above completed successfully.
- The original intermittent failure has not been reproduced before the fix in this validation session.

## Does this pull request potentially affect one of the following parts:

- Dependencies: no.
- Public API: no.
- Serializers: no.
- Runtime per-record code paths: no.
- Deployment or recovery: no production changes; this change only updates tests.
- S3 file system connector: no.

## Documentation

- Introduces a new feature: no.
- Documentation: not applicable; the test helper explains the threading requirement.
